_doc: C10 viewport overflow allowlist (f385). A rule needs id, metric, routes (regex), class (intended|followup), a reason of 40+ characters and, for a followup, max (the count of hits may fall, never rise: test_viewport_overflow.mjs compares against HEAD) and a followup number from the receipt. Anything matching no rule fails the sweep. Overflow, off-viewport element and footer defects have no rules: all were fixed.

rules.reason: Checkbox and small form inputs under 44px at 360; follow-up 4 in the f385 receipt, needs label-wrapped hit areas per form.
